particle_canvas.name: particle_canvas
particle_canvas.why_avoid: Every SaaS landing page has this. It's visual noise that adds nothing.

glitch_text.name: glitch_text
glitch_text.why_avoid: Overused in 'edgy' portfolios. Usually hurts readability.

scanlines.name: scanlines
scanlines.why_avoid: Fake nostalgia that adds loading time and nothing else.

custom_cursor.name: custom_cursor
custom_cursor.why_avoid: Accessibility nightmare. Users expect system cursors.

gradient_mesh.name: gradient_mesh
gradient_mesh.why_avoid: Every startup copied Apple. Time to move on.

blob_morphing.name: blob_morphing
blob_morphing.why_avoid: Became a cliché after every UI kit included them.

noise_texture.name: noise_texture
noise_texture.why_avoid: Usually just adds file size. Rarely adds value.

colors.description: Color schemes that have been done to death

gradient_trendy.name: gradient_trendy
gradient_trendy.why_avoid: Indistinguishable from a million other sites.

dark_mode_default.name: dark_mode_default
dark_mode_default.why_avoid: Dark mode is fine, but it's become lazy default.

pastel_everything.name: pastel_everything
pastel_everything.why_avoid: Overused in productivity/wellness apps. Feels generic.

layouts.description: Structural patterns that have become visual white noise

hero_generic.name: hero_generic
hero_generic.why_avoid: Users scroll past without reading. It's invisible.

card_grid.name: card_grid
card_grid.why_avoid: Information gets lost in visual sameness.

bento_boxes.name: bento_boxes
bento_boxes.why_avoid: Trendy in 2023, already tired. Use with caution.

fullscreen_sections.name: fullscreen_sections
fullscreen_sections.why_avoid: Breaks natural reading flow. Frustrates users.

sticky_everything.name: sticky_everything
examples: Sticky nav + sticky sidebar + sticky CTA
sticky_everything.why_avoid: Reduces actual content space. Mobile nightmare.

interactions.description: Animation and interaction patterns that are overdone

parallax.name: parallax
parallax.why_avoid: Often causes motion sickness. Usually pointless.

scroll_reveal.name: scroll_reveal
scroll_reveal.why_avoid: Slows down content consumption. Gets annoying.

hover_effects_classic.name: hover_effects_classic
hover_effects_classic.why_avoid: So common they're invisible. No differentiation.

loading_animations.name: loading_animations
loading_animations.why_avoid: Usually hides poor performance. Just make it faster.

typography.description: Text treatments that have become clichés

distortion_acid.name: distortion_acid
distortion_acid.why_avoid: Sacrifices readability for 'art'. Usually fails at both.

variable_font_tricks.name: variable_font_tricks
examples: Animating variable font axes for effect

giant_headlines.name: giant_headlines
giant_headlines.why_avoid: Everyone does this now. Lost its impact.

components.description: UI components that have been cloned into oblivion

glassmorphism_cards.name: glassmorphism_cards
glassmorphism_cards.why_avoid: Every component library has this. No longer distinctive.

neumorphism_buttons.name: neumorphism_buttons
neumorphism_buttons.why_avoid: Poor contrast. Accessibility nightmare. The trend is dead.

floating_labels.name: floating_labels
examples: Input labels that animate from placeholder to top
floating_labels.why_avoid: Actually causes usability issues. Use static labels.

rounded_everything.name: rounded_everything
rounded_everything.why_avoid: Became the default. Sharp edges are refreshing now.

icon_overload.name: icon_overload
examples: Icons for everything, even when text is clearer
icon_overload.why_avoid: Icons are ambiguous. Words are clear.
